summary: This Form 6-K filed by Bank of Nova Scotia reports a routine dividend increase of $0.04 per share to $1.14 per share, payable July 29, 2026 to holders of record July 7, 2026. It also notes that under the Shareholder Dividend and Share Purchase Plan, shares will be purchased on the open market rather than issued from treasury. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign. This is a standard quarterly dividend announcement with no strategic corporate action.
